section.about.teaser: The Omnia mixed choir was founded in 2003 at the University of Žilina and has operated as a civic association since 2016. The choir is led by conductor Monika Bažíková. We sing repertoire from Renaissance to contemporary, including bold, sonically and visually striking works. We regularly represent Slovakia at international competitions and welcome new singers and audiences at our concerts.
section.about.text1: Omnia is a mixed choir with a rich history and international awards. We perform repertoire from Renaissance to contemporary and regularly appear at concerts and competitions in Slovakia and abroad.
section.about.text2: The choir was founded as a community of enthusiastic singers who wish to preserve and present quality choral music. Our performances include sacred works, spiritual motets, and secular compositions from the baroque through romanticism to works by contemporary composers. In addition to our own activities, we collaborate with orchestras and participate in international festivals and competitions.
section.about.quote: Music connects. The choir creates community.
section.about.conductor: doc. Mgr. art. et Mgr. Monika Bažíková, ArtD.
section.donate.text: Your support enables us to prepare new projects, perform at home and abroad, and nurture choral tradition.

page.aboutChoir.title: About the choir
page.aboutChoir.intro: Omnia is a mixed choir with a rich history and international awards. Here you will find more information about our history, repertoire and activities.
page.aboutChoir.heroStatement: A community of voices from Žilina that for more than two decades has built bridges between the past and present of choral music.
page.aboutChoir.storyP1: The Omnia choir was founded in 2003 at the University of Žilina. From the beginning it has brought together students, alumni, and friends of the university who share a love of choral singing.
page.aboutChoir.storyP2: Since 2016 we have operated as a civic association (OZ); despite the change in legal form, we remain an open community with an international reputation. Each year brings new challenges, new works, and new friendships.
page.aboutChoir.storyP3: Our performances are meeting places — for us, for the audience, and for the music itself.
page.aboutChoir.repertoireIntro: The choir's repertoire spans centuries: from Renaissance motets through Baroque oratorios to works by contemporary composers.
page.aboutChoir.repertoireP1: We focus on unconventional, sonically and visually interesting compositions alongside sacred works, spiritual motets, and secular repertoire. We collaborate with orchestras and regularly premiere new arrangements.
page.aboutChoir.repertoireP2: Music is our language — we speak without words. Every piece is a story we want to share.
page.aboutChoir.conductorBio: She leads us with attention to detail, expertise, and a love for choral tradition.
page.aboutChoir.conductorQuote: Music connects. The choir creates community.
page.aboutChoir.ctaSentence: Every voice counts. Every note matters. Become part of the story.
page.aboutChoir.historyText: The Omnia choir was founded in 2003 at the University of Žilina; since 2016 it has operated as a civic association. We have approximately 45 members and regularly perform at concerts and competitions at home and abroad.
page.aboutChoir.repertoireText: We perform repertoire from Renaissance to contemporary. Our programmes include sacred works, spiritual motets and secular compositions from the baroque through romanticism to works by contemporary composers.
page.aboutChoir.cooperationText: In addition to our own concert activities, we collaborate with orchestras and participate in international festivals and competitions. We regularly host guest conductors and composers.

news.article.staromestske.title: Staromestské slávnosti in Žilina
news.article.staromestske.excerpt: OMNIA choir performs on Mariánske námestie as part of the region's largest city celebration.
news.article.staromestske.body.p1: The OMNIA choir is pleased to take part in Staromestské slávnosti in Žilina — an event that brings music, dance, and community to the historic city centre each year.
news.article.staromestske.body.p2: Our performance on Mariánske námestie will offer a varied choral programme bridging classical elegance with the energy of contemporary interpretation. We look forward to sharing the atmosphere that defines Žilina's cultural summer at its finest.
news.article.staromestske.body.p3: We hope to see you on 30 May 2026 at 4:00 PM. Further details about the festival programme are available on the organiser's website.
news.article.donio.title: Support us: Olympic dream on Donio
news.article.donio.excerpt: We have launched a public fundraiser for our journey to the World Choir Games. Every gift brings us closer to Sweden.
news.article.donio.body.p1: The road to the World Choir Games in Helsingborg is the highlight of OMNIA's 2026 season — and a challenge that calls for the whole choir community to pull together.
news.article.donio.body.p2: On Donio we have opened a transparent campaign, "Olympijský sen", covering travel, accommodation, and preparation for participants. With your support we can represent Slovakia with the same dedication we bring to every concert at home.
news.article.donio.body.p3: Every contribution — however small — means a great deal to us. Thank you for being part of our story.
news.article.terchova.title: Cyrilometodské dni in Terchová – joint concert with ŠKO Žilina
news.article.terchova.excerpt: On 5 July 2026 OMNIA and the Žilina State Chamber Orchestra perform together in Terchová.
news.article.terchova.body.p1: Cyrilometodské dni in Terchová are among the region's most prominent summer events. OMNIA will appear in a joint concert with the Žilina State Chamber Orchestra.
news.article.terchova.body.p2: The evening programme combines choral works with orchestral accompaniment, offering listeners a distinctive experience in the heart of a village rich in cultural heritage.
news.article.terchova.body.p3: We look forward to seeing you in Terchová on 5 July 2026. Admission to this public event follows the organiser's programme — follow our social channels for updates.
news.article.terchova.body.p4: Complete festival information and the detailed schedule are available on the official Terchová event page.
page.join.title: Join us
page.join.intro: Do you have a connection to choral music? We warmly welcome new voices who wish to create and grow with us. Get in touch — we will be happy to tell you more about rehearsals and how you can get involved.
page.join.heroSubtitle: We are looking for new voices with a passion for music and the desire to experience the atmosphere of world-class stages.
page.join.why1Body: We grow artistically with a modern repertoire and unconventional works — from classics to contemporary pieces. Every rehearsal is a space to discover and refine your sound.
page.join.why2Body: We regularly represent the choir at international competitions and festivals. Connecting with other cultures and travelling together is part of who we are.
page.join.why3Body: We are friendships that last beyond the stage. Shared moments, celebrations, and trips strengthen our community.
page.join.whoBody: All voice parts are welcome — soprano, alto, tenor, and bass. If you want to sing, learn, and be part of a team that carries music at heart, you are in the right place.
